obs: - [friction] Creating a list fails silently until a Folder is chosen, even though the only option is the auto-created 'Your First Folder', adding two extra clicks to a basic action.
- [benefit] Once the folder was picked, the 'Demo Alpha Newsletter' list was created from a side panel and appeared immediately in the lists table with its ID and folder.
- [friction] The Campaigns listing page showed only a spinner for 15+ seconds across three observations and never rendered, so I could not start the welcome, feature-update or promo drafts.
- [friction] A fresh free account shows a persistent red 'Your account is under review' banner across every page, pointing to a Deliverability center.

- [friction] In the Marketing menu, Forms carries a lock icon and Landing pages a paid-plan crown on the new free account, so a sign-up form to feed a new-subscriber automation is not immediately available.
- [benefit] The sidebar clearly groups CRM (Contacts, Lists, Segments) and Marketing (Campaigns, Statistics, Templates) plus Automations, so the areas the task needs were easy to locate.
